fields.title: Gulf manufacturers prioritise local content requirements as procurement shifts from imported to domestic supply
fields.seoTitle: Gulf manufacturers prioritise local content requirements as
fields.seoDescription: LEAP and Industrial Expo programming emphasise localisation as procurement driver across multiple sectors.
fields.excerpt: Local content requirements embedded in major project contracts are reshaping supply chain strategies for manufacturers across the Gulf.
fields.content: Saudi Arabia's localisation programme, UAE industrial diversification goals and Qatar's supplier preference policies collectively create incentives for domestic manufacturing capacity. Companies building assembly, component manufacturing or sub-assembly facilities in the Gulf expect premium pricing and contract preference in public and state-owned enterprise procurement. International suppliers are establishing manufacturing joint ventures or local assembly facilities to meet localisation thresholds that now reach 70-80 percent on major infrastructure projects.
